title: Documented macOS bootstrap executes unauthenticated HTTP sources
description:
The documented bootstrap downloads GNU sources over plain HTTP without pinned authentication/integrity, executes configure/make and invokes sudo make install. A network intermediary can replace executable source. Use authenticated initial transport and verified artifact authenticity/integrity in a private workspace with fail-fast checks. Independently confirmed from source; no download or external probe, no risk acceptance. Next action: coordinator assigns a focused repair and relevant regression.
